# Best noise-cancelling headphones under $200

My search results didn't include direct retailer links for most of these. The linked review pages have current price buttons for Amazon, Best Buy and others. Prices move, so check them before buying.

## My top picks

**Best overall: JBL Live 780NC**
- RTINGS ranks it the best ANC under $200. Its noise isolation competes with Sony and Bose flagships.
- Battery lasts 60 hours, and it has multipoint, LDAC and a wired option.
- The downsides are high clamping force and mediocre headband padding, so it may be uncomfortable for larger heads.
- It "sometimes" sits just under $200, so watch for a sale.
- [RTINGS review and prices](https://www.rtings.com/headphones/reviews/best/noise-cancelling-headphones-under-200)

**Best value: Anker Soundcore Space Q45**
- RTINGS calls it the best budget ANC headphone. It costs around $100 and quiets engine rumble and office chatter.
- Battery lasts about 28 hours with ANC on.
- Some units have an ANC hiss, and some owners report headband or hinge breakage.
- [RTINGS review and prices](https://www.rtings.com/headphones/reviews/best/budget-noise-cancelling-headphones)

**Best all-rounder at the $200 limit: Sony ULT WEAR**
- RTINGS picks it for calls. SoundGuys measured more than 25 dB of attenuation above 80 Hz, the strongest low-frequency result of its four picks.
- It has multipoint, LDAC and a wired option, and SoundGuys found the over-ear fit the most comfortable of its four picks.
- Battery is around 32 hours.
- It's listed at $200. [RatingMobile summary](https://ratingmobile.com/articles/en/best-noise-cancelling-headphones-under-200)

**Best sound: Sennheiser Accentum Plus**
- It has a smooth, warm tuning and a parametric EQ in the app, and battery lasts about 56 hours.
- Its ANC is weaker than the Q45's, especially on low rumble like plane engines.
- aptX Adaptive isn't supported natively by Apple devices.
- [RTINGS review and prices](https://www.rtings.com/headphones/reviews/best/by-price/under-200)

## Other options

- **Cheapest decent ANC: JLab JBuds Lux ANC (~$80).** It has 44 hours of battery, but SoundGuys measured only 10–20 dB of cancellation below 700 Hz. That's fine for a bus or office, but not for a plane. [Tom's Guide list](https://www.tomsguide.com/us/best-noise-cancelling-headphones%2Creview-5566.html)
- **Sony WH-CH730N (~$176–179 at Amazon and Best Buy).** Tom's Guide praises its sound, ANC, comfort and battery (up to 75 hours with ANC off), but finds the US price high. [Tom's Guide review](https://www.tomsguide.com/audio/headphones/sony-wh-ch730n-review)
- **Soundcore Space One Pro ($199.99 list).** It has 40 hours of battery with ANC on and LDAC. Tom's Guide names it its best under $200. A coupon site, Dealectric, reports code AFSC20 took $39.99 off in Soundcore's cart on Oct 22, 2026, for about $160. That's their claim, so confirm at checkout. This is an affiliate link: [Buy at Soundcore](https://dealectric.com/go/soundcore-space-one-pro). Details are on [Dealectric's page](https://dealectric.com/soundcore-space-one-pro).
- **Sturdier build: CMF Headphone Pro.** It has stainless-steel hinges and splash resistance, but I don't have its price or its ANC results. [RTINGS](https://www.rtings.com/headphones/reviews/best/budget-noise-cancelling-headphones)

## Quick guide
- **Strongest ANC for the money:** JBL Live 780NC or Sony ULT WEAR
- **Tightest budget:** Soundcore Space Q45 or JLab JBuds Lux ANC
- **Sound quality:** Sennheiser Accentum Plus
- **Longest battery:** JBL Live 780NC (60 hours)

If you tell me your phone (iPhone or Android), whether you'll mostly use them for flights, commuting or the office, and your head size, I can narrow it to one.
